documents.title: Seasonal pattern of latex spoilage (aggregate)
documents.summary: Pre-coagulation is the largest spoilage cause in every season. Its share of total spoilage is about 71% in June-August versus about 47% in December-February. Aggregates only; no estate or worker records.

documents.title: Spoilage by collection-to-factory time band (aggregate)
documents.summary: Total spoilage averages 3.6% of latex collected where the collection-to-factory time is under 2.5 hours, against 5.3% where it exceeds 3.5 hours. Cells with fewer than three estates are suppressed.

documents.title: Cause mix across the year (aggregate)
documents.summary: Contamination losses stay between 0.77% and 0.85% of latex collected in every month, so they are a steady, controllable cause. Temperature-related losses peak in March-May at about 1.1% of latex collected.

documents.title: Current gap - no lot-level quality trending at factory receipt
documents.summary: Collection time is logged at the collection point, but factory receipt does not yet trend quality results per lot or per collection round, so drift is found late. (Owner-stated gap.)
